item.text:
THOUGHT:
The mathematical derivations and recorded errors are correct, and the manuscript carefully explains why exact fit occurs and which observations support the reported scores. Its contribution is nevertheless limited to packaging elementary intercept-fitting facts into a small exercise. The review should recognize that instructional scope while examining whether the exercise offers a sufficiently distinctive, well-grounded educational contribution. Missing literature engagement and the absence of contrasting worked examples or learner evidence substantially weaken that case.

The note derives the squared-error decomposition establishing mean-residual optimality and the condition for zero error, gives a pairing argument establishing median-residual optimality under absolute error, and supplies R code and error values for three offsets. Diagnostic prompts ask learners to connect optimality, exact fit, objective-specific minimizers, and the reuse of target observations in fitting and evaluation.",
